name: Mizoguchi Toyoharu
source:
Zodiac: Sagittarius

Head accountant to the mansion and main assistant to the master.

He always has the same expression, seemingly serene and calm. He likes fishing, baseball and sumo.

Most of his jobs are now performed by Sakuma and thus he spends his days relaxing.
